name: Fidelidade - Companhia de Seguros
note: Portuguese insurer. Its shareholders page lists Fosun Group (through Millennium Gain Limited) with 84.9892% and Caixa Geral de Depósitos (CGD), a bank owned by the Portuguese State, with 15%. It keeps 60% of Luz Saúde (Hospital da Luz) after selling 40% to Macquarie European Infrastructure Fund 7; the sale was completed on 29 January 2026, with Fidelidade keeping a controlling position (ECO).
